header.running_head: Learning, Teaching and Rehearsing the Knowledge of Deen and Questions that are Appropriate and those that are Inappropriate

blocks.text: Hadhrat Umar (RA) explained, "When some people from amongst the Muhaajireen had certain doubts about their lineage, they said, 'We wish that Allaah would reveal verses of the Qur'aan concerning our lineage.' It was then that Allaah revealed the verse you have just recited." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then asked Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) about Hadhrat Ali bin Abi Taalib (RA) saying, "I know that if that companion of yours assumes the post of Khilaafah, he will be abstinent. However, I fear that he should not be carried away by conceit." "What are you saying, O Ameerul Mu'mineen?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) exclaimed, "You are well aware of (the virtues of) our companion. By Allaah! He has never changed or spoiled (after the demise of Rasulullaah ﷺ) and has never offended Rasulullaah ﷺ as long as he stayed with Rasulullaah ﷺ." Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked, "And what about Abu Jahal's daughter that he wanted to marry while Faatima (RA) was still his wife (did this not upset Rasulullaah ﷺ)?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) replied by arguing, "Concerning the decisive error Hadhrat Aadam (AS) made, Allaah says:
...but he forgot and We did not find him to be determined (to disobey Our command).

Similarly, our companion was not determined to offend Rasulullaah ﷺ. The idea was merely a thought that no person is capable of driving out of the mind. In addition to this, people with a deep understanding and profound knowledge of Allaah's Deen are also prone to err sometimes. However, they retract and repent as soon as they are alerted." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "A person will be sorely mistaken if he thinks that he will ever be able to dive and reach the depths (of knowledge and wisdom) with people like you." [^1]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Asks Hadhrat Aa'isha (RA) About a Hadith that Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) Reported about Attending Funerals

Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA) reports that he was once sitting with Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) when Hadhrat Khabbaab came there saying, "O Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)! Have you heard what Abu Hurayrah (RA) is saying? He claims to have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say, 'When a person accompanies a funeral bier from the house, performs the Janaazah salaah and then follows it until it has been buried, he will receive the reward of two Qiraats, each Qiraat being equal to Mount Uhud in magnitude. As for the person who returns after performing the Janaazah salaah, he shall have a reward equal in magnitude to Mount Uhud'." Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) sent Hadhrat Khabbaab to Hadhrat Aa'isha
Zubayr bin Bakkaar in his Muwaffaqiyaat, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.229).
